catalog migrate.description: Plan, apply, or resume an audited non-destructive migration from the legacy catalog.

import <source>.description: Safely import a local React file, directory, stdin source, or 21st.dev paste into an immutable revision.

catalog locate.description: Resolve the catalog path without creating a catalog.

catalog list.description: List every catalog component with its category, bucket, tags, and description, plus collections.

catalog rebuild.description: Rebuild the SQLite search index from committed manifests.

search <query>.description: Search the manifest-derived SQLite FTS index with deterministic ranking and selection evidence.

inspect <component-id-or-alias>.description: Inspect an exact component ID or alias and an optional immutable revision.

catalog validate.description: Read-only validation of the legacy catalog and metadata.

project inspect --cwd <path>.description: Read bounded React project conventions, tokens, dependencies, and validation commands.

adapt <component-id>.description: Prepare a deterministic destination-native adaptation without changing the destination project.

add <component-id>.description: Plan or explicitly apply manifest-listed adaptation files.

validate <adaptation-manifest>.description: Run only the validation commands declared by an adaptation manifest.

agent link.description: Link the repository-owned Blockbase skills and executable into an agent home.

agent check.description: Check the repository-owned Blockbase links in an agent home.

agent unlink.description: Remove only the repository-owned Blockbase links from an agent home.

agent install.description: Install a provider package into project or global scope with an ownership inventory.

agent update.description: Update only the Blockbase-owned provider payload and preserve unrelated configuration.

agent remove.description: Remove only Blockbase-owned provider records from project or global scope.

inbox add (--path | -).description: Parks a paste, 21st.dev paste, or local path without importing it.

inbox import <id>.description: Imports a parked inbox item into the catalog.

tag add <component>.description: Adds a tag on one component manifest.

tag remove <component>.description: Removes a tag from one component manifest.

tag list [component].description: Lists tags for one component or the whole catalog.

collection add.description: Adds a component slug to a collection.

collection remove.description: Removes a component slug from a collection.

collection reorder.description: Moves a slug within a collection.

collection delete.description: Deletes a collection other than favorites.

family set <component>.description: Assigns a component family, creating it when requested.

family list.description: Lists taxonomy families and unassigned categories.

history list [component].description: Lists recent catalog changes, newest first, for the whole catalog or one component.

history undo.description: Rolls the whole catalog back by --steps changes or --to a commit, as a new undoable commit.

history restore <component>.description: Puts one component back as it was at --to <commit>, leaving the rest of the catalog alone.

setup.description: Create the catalog if absent and install the user login service that serves the catalog page.

ui.description: Serve the local catalog page on a loopback port until interrupted.

ui status.description: Report whether the catalog page is answering on its loopback port.

ui service install.description: Install the user login service that keeps the catalog page running.

ui service uninstall.description: Remove the user login service that Blockbase installed.

ui service status.description: Report the user login service state without changing it.
